## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `azure-policy-arc` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `azure-policy-arc` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `arc-policy-assignments`, `arc-policy-remediation-tasks`, `arc-compliance-state`

**Validation artifacts:** `arc-policy-manifest.json`, `arc-remediation-audit.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/azure-policy-arc/azure-policy-arc.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `CM-2`, `CM-3`, `CM-6`, `CM-8`, `CA-7`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **CM-2** Baseline Configuration | Primary | Initiative assignments are the canonical mechanism for declaring the server-side configuration baseline; deviations surface as policy non-compliance. |
| **CM-3** Configuration Change Control | Primary | Remediation task dispatch is the canon-authorized change-control surface for server-side configuration drift. |
| **CM-6** Configuration Settings | Primary | Per-resource policy compliance state is the canonical evidence source for server-side configuration setting verification. |
| **CM-8** Information System Component Inventory | Supporting | Compliance-state plus assignment manifest produces a per-server policy inventory keyed to OrgPath segment. |
| **CA-7** Continuous Monitoring | Primary | Scheduled compliance evaluation provides continuous policy posture evidence; new non-compliance appears in subsequent runs. |
